description: Hyperliquid perp candles for one coin as parallel arrays t/o/h/l/c/v. `coin` is the bare Hyperliquid coin (BTC, not BTC-PERP; HIP-3 coins are dex-prefixed, e.g. xyz:NVDA). `interval` sets the bar size (default 1h). `from`/`to` are unix MILLISECONDS (default the last 7 days); returned `t` is unix seconds.

coin.description:
Bare Hyperliquid coin (BTC, kPEPE) or Discover's perp id (BTC-PERP);
HIP-3 coins are dex-prefixed, e.g. xyz:NVDA.

from.description: Window start, unix MILLISECONDS, not seconds (default 7 days before `to`).

to.description: Window end, unix MILLISECONDS, not seconds (default now).

name: get_perp_candles
title: Get perp candles
